subject: Renewal QBR & roadmap demo — milemarker scheduling and exec coverage
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Meyer <alicia.meyer@medalytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Jun 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal QBR / roadmap demo — two windows and runbook (draft attached)

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for the time last week. As we prep the renewal QBR and the roadmap demo for MediAlytics, I want to propose a compact "milemarker" format that surfaces the product roadmap items that map to your FY29 priorities plus a short exec handoff.

Can you confirm which of these two windows works for your team next week? We can compress the session to 45 minutes if execs only have a 20–30 minute availability.

- Option A: Tue 2028-06-27 10:00–11:30 PT (90 min — full walkthrough + breakouts)
- Option B: Tue 2028-06-27 14:00–14:45 PT (45 min — tightly focused milemarker + exec recap)

I've attached a draft runbook (QBR_Runbook_v2.pdf) with a suggested compressed agenda and the parts we'd like your team to sign off on (data residency, private deployment options, and SLA gates). If you prefer a compressed agenda we will drop the breakout and focus on the migration + cost/latency controls.

Also, quick ask: if Tom or another exec can join for 15 minutes, we will reserve the final segment for an executive recap and next steps (procurement onramp). If not, we'll record and send a short highlight doc.

Calendly link for quick slot confirmation: https://calendly.com/redwood/qbr-90min-demo?month=2028-06

Thanks — short next step please (pick A/B or propose alternate).

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attached: QBR_Runbook_v2.pdf]

From: Alicia Meyer <alicia.meyer@medalytics.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Chen <tom.chen@medalytics.com>, SalesOps <salesops@medalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR / roadmap demo — two windows and runbook (draft attached)

Hi Grace —

Appreciate the prep and the runbook. Our exec calendar is tight that week; Tom can do a 30-minute slot at lunch but not the morning full session. For the broader team, the only available windows we can guarantee are:

- Tue 2028-06-27 12:15–13:00 PT (Tom can join first 20–25 mins)
- Wed 2028-06-28 08:30–09:30 PT (broader team, but Tom cannot make it)

We prefer a compressed 45-minute format that focuses on the migration path, the dedicated/private deployment options, and the thing we care about most — predictable tail-latency under batch traffic. If you can compress to 40–45 minutes and reserve ~10–15 minutes for Tom, that would be ideal.

I've attached our availability matrix (MediAlytics_Availability.ics) for reference. Also, quick flag — procurement wants any renewal addenda surfaced in advance; we may surface an initial PO path during the exec segment.

Thanks,
Alicia
Head of Platform Partnerships, MediAlytics
[Attached: MediAlytics_Availability.ics]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 23 Jun 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: internal: compressed milemarker proposal + runbook edits

Grace / Jordan —

Putting together the compressed agenda to match their ask. Proposal (45 minutes total):

- 0–2 min: quick welcome & objectives (Grace)
- 2–18 min: roadmap milemarkers mapped to MediAlytics priorities (Karthik — 16 min)
- 18–30 min: migration & deployment patterns that hit their latency SLOs (Jordan — 12 min)
- 30–40 min: procurement/onramp + pricing guardrails (Grace — 10 min)
- 40–45 min: exec recap (Tom joins for the final 8–10 min)

Jordan, can you take the migration section and ensure we have two short slides: 1) KV/cache behavior at 2–6s seq lengths, 2) fallback routing and cost controls. I updated QBR_Runbook_v2 in Drive with the compressed agenda: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1a2b3-QBR-Runbook-v2

One more ops note: if Tom can only join the first part of the session, we should reverse the order so execs hear the high-level ask first; but Alicia specifically called out a short Tom window at lunch (first 20–25m). So we will keep the exec recap at the end and ask Tom to join early if possible.

I'll draft the final runbook edits and share before Monday.

—Karthik
Director, Solutions Architecture, Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Meyer <alicia.meyer@medalytics.com>, Tom Chen <tom.chen@medalytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: 2028-06-27 12:15–13:00 PT — compressed milemarker demo (45 min)

Alicia / Tom —

Thanks for the quick reply and the availability file. Confirming the compressed milemarker demo for today:

When: Tue, 27 Jun 2028, 12:15–13:00 PT (45 minutes)
Where: Google Meet link (invite sent)
Agenda (compressed):
- 0–2m: Welcome & desired outcomes (Grace)
- 2–18m: Roadmap milemarkers aligned to MediAlytics priorities (Karthik)
- 18–30m: Migration pattern & latency controls (Jordan)
- 30–38m: Procurement onramp & pricing guardrails (Grace)
- 38–45m: Exec highlights & next steps (Tom, if available)

Attached is the final runbook for this compressed format (QBR_Runbook_v2.pdf — updated 2028-06-27). I also added a one-page highlights doc we'll send to Procurement right after the session.

Doc: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1a2b3-QBR-Runbook-v2
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-6359

If Tom can't make the final segment, we'll capture the 2–3 exec bullets and circulate immediately. Meeting invite and the recording + 1-page highlights will be posted to the Drive folder within 24 hours.

See you shortly —
Grace
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attached: QBR_Runbook_v2.pdf]
